title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music, captivating the audience with their performance.

title: Joy Maa Durga
desc: After multiple attempts, Jyoti and Somu, a young couple, are blessed with a child by Goddess Durga. However, the deity warns Jyoti that Somu will die if he lays eyes on his son.

title: Sindoor Niye Khela
desc: Varsha is a powerful businesswoman, but faces opposition from her workers. In order to solve the problem, she marries the leader of the workers' union.

title: Rajar Meye Parul
desc: A childless king marries a woodcutter's daughter to gain an heir. However, his wives kill his seven children, leaving only his daughter Parul, who grows up to be a charming young lady.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: A wealthy mill owner, Durgadas Prasad, hires a secretary to handle his office work. She falls in love with Billoo, who incidentally happens to be Durgadas' estranged grandson.

title: Rupban
desc: A 12-year-old Rupban is married to Rahim when he is just 12 days old. However, their lives take a turn when Rahim grows older, only to refuse to accept Rupban as his wife and fall in love with Tajel.
